name: War and Peace
body:
Si vis pacem, para bellum (“If you want peace, prepare for war”)

Prerequisite(s): Thaun, Knowledge (history) 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate and Diplomacy checks made to sway an opponent’s attitude during combat.
